title: A lithium-selective “OR-gate” enables fast-kinetics and ultra-stable Li-rich cathodes for polymer-based solid-state batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05264A, Paper
Qin Wang, Yiming Zhang, Meng Yao, Kang Li, Lv Xu, Haitao Zhang, Xiaopeng Wang, Yun Zhang
A negative OR gate on the surface of lithium rich layered oxide enhances the transport of Li+, making it an ideal choice for solid polymer electrolyte systems.
